description: HP-UX Kernel Crypto Module (HP-UX KCM) is a kernel-space shared library in the HP-UX OS containing core cryptographic algorithms in one central place. It implements asymmetric, symmetric, message authentication, and digest operations used by various HP-UX products. It is available on HP-UX 11i v3 OS on HPE Integrity Platform.
